Chapter 1175 - 1 Xia Qin The Supreme: Galaxy Has Become The Great Saint? (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1175: Chapter 1 Xia Qin the Supreme: Galaxy has become the Great Saint? (Seeking subscription)

Xuan Huang Universe.

Lin Yuan was planning to leave; this trip to the Xuan Huang Universe had basically come to an end.

Just now, the Xuanhuang himself intervened personally, gathering all the treasures and rare items from various regions of the universe and then giving them to Lin Yuan.

There was no need for Lin Yuan to search for them himself anymore.

Everything of value in the entire Xuan Huang Universe was basically in Lin Yuan’s hands now.

Suddenly—

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed as the space-time in front of him distorted slightly.

Next, a large number of treasures fell out from the depths of the distorted space-time, suspended before Lin Yuan.

"These treasures?"

Lin Yuan’s pupils slightly contracted.

The treasures that fell out were not many, only a dozen or so, but the aura they exuded was shocking to Lin Yuan.

"Life Divine Stone?"

Lin Yuan looked at one of the crystal stones.

This crystal stone was only the size of a fist, far smaller than the life divine stone the size of three meters that Lin Yuan had obtained.

Yet for some reason, the instant Lin Yuan saw this crystal stone, he vaguely felt it was far more precious than the life divine stone.

"This is not a Life Divine Stone; this is a Life Origin Stone!"

Many thoughts floated in Lin Yuan’s mind.

Life Divine Stone.

Life Origin Stone.

Although they differ by only a word.

The two are entirely different things.

If one speaks of mysterious places in the Chaos Void—the Sea of Life periodically drops Life Divine Stones.

Then the Life Origin Stone is the foundation of the Sea of Life.

The relationship between the Life Divine Stone and the Life Origin Stone is like that of the offspring and the parent body.

As long as the parent body is there, theoretically, it can generate countless offspring.

For this reason, the Life Origin Stone has almost never appeared in the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan recognized the identity of this crystal stone only after receiving the information delivered by the Moyu Tower Master.

"The Life Origin Star of this universe should be a small piece of Life Origin Stone, hence, borrowing the special rule environment around it, it can nurture a Life Divine Stone, akin to a smaller Sea of Life."

Lin Yuan thought to himself in silence.

Such a rare item as the Life Stone, even the Great Saints who can set specific rules find it hard to directly nurture it; they must rely on external force.

Otherwise, throughout the history of the Chaos Void, many Great Saints were born, and if they all started nurturing Life Divine Stones, such rare items would not be so precious and scarce, even the Chaos Great Saints would find them hard to come by.

Up until now, Lin Yuan only confirmed that the Xuanhuang Universe could nurture Life Divine Stones.

And the external force required to nurture a Life Divine Stone is the Life Origin Stone.

However.

To create an environment conducive to nurturing Life Divine Stones, the Life Origin Stone must be fully integrated into the universe, forming the special rules of the Sea of Life.

In such circumstances, the Life Origin Stone becomes one with the entire universe, inseparable.

Even the Xuanhuang, the creator of the universe, can’t revert that Life Origin Star into a Life Origin Stone.

However, this fist-sized Life Origin Stone before his eyes... Lin Yuan looked at the Life Origin Stone as if he was seeing endless Life Divine Stones.

Aside from the Life Origin Stone, the other treasures and rare items that fell simultaneously are equally mind-boggling.

Primordial Mineral Crystal.

Nine Heavens Thunder Core.

Origin Soil of Myriad.

...

Each treasure is not at all inferior to the Life Origin Stone, stemming from some mysterious places, or even being the foundation of those places.

The so-called mysterious places refer to places related to thirteenth-order life forms.

Throughout the long Cosmic Era in the Chaos Void, many Invincible Great Saints were born, possessing the power to forcibly enter the mysterious places, yet they dare not do much.

Worried about attracting the attention of the thirteenth-order time life behind the mysterious places.

Even though the probability is minuscule, the Invincible Great Saints dare not gamble on it; compared to other Great Saints, they are more aware of the formidable power held by time life forms.

But the Xuanhuang?

The Xuanhuang forcibly broke free from the time loop, destined to vanish, naturally indifferent to whether the thirteenth-order time life pays attention to him.

That’s why he dared to directly visit one mysterious place after another demanding benefits.

The spirits of those mysterious places understand this, although unwilling, as long as they worry the Xuanhuang might start a war heedless of everything, they can only swallow this loss.

The spirits of those mysterious places are also reluctant to seek help from the thirteenth-order time life behind them.

...

"Your Majesty."

Lin Yuan looked at the treasures in front of him and naturally understood that they were given to him by the Xuanhuang.

Originally, Lin Yuan was perplexed about what friends the Xuanhuang wished to meet, never expecting it would be those eternally existing mysterious places.

"With these treasures, my internal universe should become even more complete."

Lin Yuan stored the dozen rare treasures, thinking silently to himself.

These rare treasures, capable of forming those mysterious places in the Chaos Void, though not the same in scale, are fundamentally consistent.

Lin Yuan instinctively feels this is beneficial to his internal universe; the ultimate goal of the thirteenth-order legacy "Infinite Void" is to transform his internal universe into something comparable to the vast structure of the Chaos Void.

The Chaos Void possesses those mysterious places, replicating them within the internal universe surely wouldn’t go wrong.

Especially the special rules formed by the mysterious places might play a crucial role for the internal universe.

Even if they don’t work.

The internal universe, by nurturing the special environment of the mysterious places, means Lin Yuan can periodically harvest a batch of rare treasures from the Chaos Void that are hard to come by.

That’s simply like a money tree.

No, it’s a grove of money trees.
